text:
amanda: Quick — OmniaHealth POC asks: single WS multiplex, streaming tokens, in-stream function/tool calls, strict JSON schema, EU residency + SSO/KMS. Need tiny copy-paste snippet, legal blurb, runbook and a 1-week 500 QPS ballpark before EOD.

raj: We support multiplexing via session_id over one websocket. Hosted OK for demo; Dedicated + sticky routing recommended for ordered tool calls and exactly-once semantics. Ephemeral tokens supported (default TTL 15m).

nate: Node snippet (copy): `const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS); ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'open',session_id:'s1',schema_hints:{patient:{id:'string'}}})); ws.on('message',m=>{const msg=JSON.parse(m); if(msg.type==='tool_call'){ ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'tool_response',session_id:msg.session_id,call_id:msg.call_id,result:JSON.stringify({ok:true})}));}});`

raj: Handshake curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/handshake -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -d '{"session_id":"s1","schema_hints":{}}'` -> returns `{ws_url,expires_in}`.

legal-bot: Draft legal blurb: "Runtime keeps KV/cache in-memory for session duration; in Dedicated/Private raw prompt/response tokens are not persisted by default. Customers may enable logs; exported logs follow retention policy. Customer-managed KMS supported; key rotation follows customer's KMS policy. Audit records for admin/provisioning available per contract"

nate: Short POC runbook: 1) Exchange IdP metadata + KMS ARN. 2) We provision EU Dedicated test pool (2-3 days) or Private (2-3 weeks). 3) POST /handshake -> ws_url. 4) Open WS, multiplex sessions, include schema_hints. 5) Reply to tool_call with tool_response JSON; make handlers idempotent. 6) After demo rotate ephemeral creds.

amanda: Ballpark for 500 QPS sustained, 1 week (EU Dedicated test)?

raj: Back-of-envelope: ~40-50M tokens/day depending on prompt size. One-week dedicated test + support & EU infra: ~25k-45k USD. Formal quote to follow.

amanda: Thanks — sending to customer now. :thumbsup:
